Luis (Japanese: オード Aude) is a minor supporting character who appeared in White—Victini and Zekrom and Black—Victini and Reshiram. He is a young boy currently living in a frozen region and a descendant of the "People of the Vale".

==In the movies==
In the beginning of Black—Victini and Reshiram, Luis was out on the frozen tundra with his mother, village leader Glacine, searching for Revival Herbs. His had just found some under the ice when a giant iceberg crashed into the glacier he and his mother were on. Both ran for cover and they were almost rescued by the arrival of Donuke. However, his sled was flipped over by a and the three were trapped on a crumbling sheet of ice, with the iceberg still incoming. They were saved by Damon, who summoned to destroy the iceberg with . He was also seen in a flashback of Damon's in White—Victini and Reshiram, where he gives Damon a bottle of Revival Herb potion.

Luis was later seen in both movies with Glacine and Donuke, as well as the people of the desert village, who all came to Eindoak Town to show their support for Damon's idea. He was also seen in the ending credits with Luisa.

Luis appears in a single panel of , where he is seen in the flashback of Damon visiting the tundra village on a journey to gather the descendants of the People of the Vale. Luis does not travel to Eindoak Town in support of Damon's plan as he does in the movie.

==Trivia==
